tools_json.title: JSON Formatter & Validator
tools_json.desc: Format JSON strings beautifully and check for syntax errors.
tools_json.usage_step1_desc: Paste the JSON string you want to format into the input field.
tools_json.usage_step2_desc: Check 'Sort keys' to alphabetically sort object keys. Use 'Compact' for 2-space indentation.
tools_json.usage_step3_desc: Click ✨ Format to prettify JSON, or 🗜️ Minify to remove whitespace and reduce size.
tools_json.usage_step4_desc: Use 📋 Copy to save the formatted JSON to clipboard. Invalid JSON will show an error message.
tools_json.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: All JSON processing happens in your browser — no data is sent to any server. Your sensitive data stays safe.

tools_base64.title: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
tools_base64.desc: Easily convert between text and Base64. UTF-8 encoding is supported.
tools_base64.usage_step1_desc: Enter the text to encode or decode. Supports all UTF-8 characters including Korean and special symbols.
tools_base64.usage_step2_desc: Click 🔼 Encode to convert text to Base64, or 🔽 Decode to restore Base64 back to original text.
tools_base64.usage_step3_desc: Use 📋 Copy to save the result to clipboard, or 🗑️ Clear to reset the input.
tools_base64.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Base64 is used in email attachments, data URIs, and API authentication tokens. Make sure the input is valid Base64 when decoding.

tools_password.title: Strong Password Generator
tools_password.desc: Generate hack-resistant random passwords instantly. All processing is done in your browser.
tools_password.usage_step1_desc: Drag the slider to set password length between 4 and 64 characters. Longer passwords are more secure.
tools_password.usage_step2_desc: Choose from Uppercase (A-Z), Lowercase (a-z), Numbers (0-9), and Symbols (!@#$...). More types = stronger passwords.
tools_password.usage_step3_desc: Click 🎲 Generate to instantly create a password, check the strength indicator, then click 📋 Copy to save it.
tools_password.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Passwords are generated in your browser and never sent to any server. 12+ characters with all character types is the most secure.

tools_url.title: URL Encoder / Decoder
tools_url.desc: Safely encode URLs containing Korean characters or special symbols.
tools_url.usage_step1_desc: Enter the URL or text you want to encode or decode.
tools_url.usage_step2_desc: Click 🔼 Encode to convert Korean, spaces, and special characters to %EB%AC%B8%EC%9E%90 format. Click 🔽 Decode to restore them.
tools_url.usage_step3_desc: Verify the converted URL and click 📋 Copy to save to clipboard. Invalid encoding will show an error.
tools_url.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: URL encoding is essential for safely transmitting URLs with query parameters containing non-ASCII characters.

tools_text_counter.title: Character Counter
tools_text_counter.desc: Count characters, words, and bytes in real time as you type.
tools_text_counter.usage_step1_desc: Type or paste the text you want to analyze.
tools_text_counter.usage_step2_desc: Statistics update instantly as you type: total characters, characters without spaces, words, lines, bytes, and sentences.
tools_text_counter.usage_step3_desc: 📋 Copy Text to copy your input, or 🗑️ Clear to reset.
tools_text_counter.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Character counters are useful for social media posts (Twitter 280 chars, Instagram 2,200), essays, and cover letters. Korean characters count as 3 bytes.

tools_color.title: Color Converter
tools_color.desc: Convert between HEX, RGB, and HSL color codes with live preview.
tools_color.usage_step1_desc: Click the color picker to select a color visually, or enter a HEX code (e.g., #4f46e5) directly.
tools_color.usage_step2_desc: RGB (rgb(79, 70, 229)) and HSL (hsl(244, 74%, 59%)) values are automatically converted and displayed.
tools_color.usage_step3_desc: Click any field to copy its value. Use 🎲 Random Color to generate random colors.
tools_color.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: HEX is the most common color format in web design, while RGB and HSL are frequently used in CSS. Use the live preview to verify colors.

tools_timestamp.title: Timestamp Converter
tools_timestamp.desc: Convert Unix timestamps (seconds/milliseconds) to date and time.
tools_timestamp.usage_step1_desc: The current Unix timestamp (seconds) and date/time are displayed at the top, auto-refreshing every second.
tools_timestamp.usage_step2_desc: Enter a Unix timestamp (seconds with 10 digits or milliseconds with 13 digits) and click 🔄 Convert. The tool auto-detects the unit.
tools_timestamp.usage_step3_desc: Click ⏰ Use Current Time to immediately convert the current timestamp. Use 📋 Copy to save results.
tools_timestamp.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Unix timestamps count seconds (or milliseconds) since January 1, 1970 (UTC). Commonly used in API responses, log files, and databases.

tools_html.title: HTML Encoder / Decoder
tools_html.desc: Convert special characters to HTML entities (<, &, etc.) and back.
tools_html.usage_step1_desc: Enter text containing HTML special characters.
tools_html.usage_step2_desc: Click 🔼 HTML Encode to convert <, >, & to HTML entities. Click 🔽 HTML Decode to restore them.
tools_html.usage_step3_desc: Click 📋 Copy to save the converted HTML to clipboard. Encoded HTML can be safely embedded in web pages.
tools_html.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: HTML encoding is essential for preventing XSS (Cross-Site Scripting) attacks and safely displaying user input on web pages.

tools_qr.title: QR Code Generator
tools_qr.desc: Convert URLs or text into QR code images.
tools_qr.api_notice: 🔒 QR codes are generated directly in your browser — no data is sent to external servers.
tools_qr.usage_step1_desc: Enter the URL or text to convert into a QR code. Examples: website URLs, contact info, Wi-Fi settings.
tools_qr.usage_step2_desc: Click 📱 Generate QR Code to instantly convert your input into a scannable QR code image.
tools_qr.usage_step3_desc: Scan the QR code with your smartphone camera, or use the 📥 Download Image link to save it as PNG.
tools_qr.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: QR codes remain stable even with long URLs. QR codes are generated directly in your browser — no data is sent to external servers.

tools_case.title: Text Case Converter
tools_case.desc: Convert text between different formats: UPPER, lower, Capital Case, snake_case, camelCase, and more.
tools_case.usage_step1_desc: Enter the text you want to convert.
tools_case.usage_step2_desc: Click the desired format: UPPERCASE (HELLO) · lowercase (hello) · Capital Case (Hello World) · snake_case (hello_world) · camelCase (helloWorld)
tools_case.usage_step3_desc: Check the converted text and click 📋 Copy to save to clipboard. Use 🗑️ Clear to reset.
tools_case.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: snake_case is commonly used for Python variables, camelCase for JavaScript. Capital Case is useful for titles and names.

tools_uuid.title: UUID Generator
tools_uuid.desc: Generate multiple UUID v4 unique identifiers instantly.
tools_uuid.usage_step1_desc: Enter the number of UUIDs to generate (1 to 100).
tools_uuid.usage_step2_desc: Click 🎲 Generate UUIDs to create the specified number of UUID v4 identifiers.
tools_uuid.usage_step3_desc: Click 📋 Copy to save all generated UUIDs to clipboard. Each UUID follows the format: xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx.
tools_uuid.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: UUIDs (Universally Unique Identifiers) are used for database primary keys, API identifiers, session tokens, and any situation requiring unique values.

feedback.link: Suggest a tool or send feedback

pwa.install_text: Add WebTools to your home screen for quick access anywhere!

tools_jwt.title: JWT Decoder
tools_jwt.desc: Decode JWT (JSON Web Token) header, payload, and signature to inspect claims.
tools_jwt.usage_step1_desc: Paste the JWT token you want to decode. e.g. eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIs...
tools_jwt.usage_step2_desc: Click 🔓 Decode to split and display the header, payload, and signature.
tools_jwt.usage_step3_desc: Use 📋 Copy buttons to save the header or payload to clipboard.
tools_jwt.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: JWTs are commonly used for server authentication. The payload is Base64Url-encoded and readable by anyone, but only the signature can verify tampering.

tools_regex.title: Regex Tester
tools_regex.desc: Test regex patterns in real time with match highlighting and replacement.
tools_regex.usage_step1_desc: Type the regex pattern to test. e.g. \d+, [a-z]+
tools_regex.usage_step2_desc: Type the string to apply the pattern to. Matches are highlighted in real time.
tools_regex.usage_step3_desc: Enter a replacement string and click 🔄 Replace to see the substituted result.
tools_regex.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: g flag = global search, i = case-insensitive, m = multiline mode.

tools_csv_json.title: CSV ↔ JSON Converter
tools_csv_json.desc: Convert CSV data to JSON array and JSON to CSV freely.
tools_csv_json.usage_step1_desc: Paste CSV or JSON data into the input area.
tools_csv_json.usage_step2_desc: Click CSV → JSON or JSON → CSV to convert.
tools_csv_json.usage_step3_desc: Verify the converted result and click 📋 Copy to save.
tools_csv_json.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: When using the first row as header, CSV converts to an array of objects. Otherwise it converts to a 2D array.

tools_css.title: CSS Formatter & Minifier
tools_css.desc: Prettify CSS code or minify it to reduce file size.
tools_css.usage_step1_desc: Paste the CSS code you want to format or minify.
tools_css.usage_step2_desc: Click ✨ Format to prettify the code, or 🗜️ Minify to remove whitespace and newlines.
tools_css.usage_step3_desc: Use 📋 Copy to save the transformed CSS to clipboard.
tools_css.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Minified CSS improves website loading speed. Formatting is useful for code review and debugging.

tools_markdown.title: Markdown Previewer
tools_markdown.desc: Render Markdown syntax to HTML in real time with live preview.
tools_markdown.usage_step1_desc: Type Markdown text. Supports # headings, **bold**, `code`, and more.
tools_markdown.usage_step2_desc: The rendered HTML is displayed in real time as you type.
tools_markdown.usage_step3_desc: Use 📋 Copy HTML to save the rendered HTML, or 💾 Download to save the Markdown file.
tools_markdown.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: This tool supports basic GitHub Flavored Markdown syntax. Preview tables, lists, code blocks, and more.

tools_px.title: PX ↔ REM/EM Converter
tools_px.desc: Convert px to rem/em with adjustable base font size.
tools_px.usage_step1_desc: Default is 16px. Adjust it to match your design system.
tools_px.usage_step2_desc: Enter a value in PX, REM, or EM and the other two units are calculated automatically.
tools_px.usage_step3_desc: Copy the converted values and use them directly in your CSS or design tool.
tools_px.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: 1rem equals the root element (html) font size. Using rem is recommended for responsive and accessible web design.

tools_image_base64.title: Image to Base64
tools_image_base64.desc: Encode image files to Base64 string via drag & drop or file picker.
tools_image_base64.drop_label: Drag & drop an image here or click to select
tools_image_base64.usage_step1_desc: Drag & drop or click to select an image file (JPG, PNG, GIF, SVG, etc.).
tools_image_base64.usage_step2_desc: The image is instantly converted to a Base64 string upon selection.
tools_image_base64.usage_step3_desc: Use 📋 Copy to save the Base64 string to clipboard, or 💾 Download to save as a text file.
tools_image_base64.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Base64-encoded images can be used directly in CSS background-image or HTML img src. Note that file size increases by about 33%.

p404.title: 404 - Page Not Found | WebTools
p404.message: The page you requested could not be found.

tools_hash.title: Text Hash Generator
tools_hash.desc: Generate SHA-256, SHA-1, and MD5 hash values in your browser in real time. No data is sent to any server.
tools_hash.usage_step1_desc: Type or paste the text you want to hash. All hash values are generated in real time as you type.
tools_hash.usage_step2_desc: SHA-256 (recommended), SHA-1, and MD5 hash results are displayed. The same input always produces the same hash.
tools_hash.usage_step3_desc: Click the 📋 Copy button next to any hash value to save it to clipboard. SHA-256 is recommended for security purposes.
tools_hash.usage_tip: 💡 Tip: Hash functions are used for password storage (with salt), file integrity verification, and digital signatures. SHA-256 is the industry standard; MD5 and SHA-1 have known vulnerabilities.
